messages:
Alex M: Heads-up — several customers reporting function-calling errors (tool_call_not_supported) after this morning's smart-routing change. Seeing spike in 5xxs from routes that should support tool calls.
Priya R: digging into routing logs now. Initial signal: context-length estimator returned small values (~64) for a large fraction of requests. Our policy maps <=128 to the q4 variant.
Sam C: I see the same in variant telemetry. The q4/quantized variant we're routing to does not advertise tool_call capability in the compatibility matrix. That feels wrong — it used to.
incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: sev=2, incident_id=INC-2101, paging oncall. Channel: #incidents.
Jen (oncall): Jen here — taking ownership. Priya, can you confirm whether this is a routing decision issue (policy) or a matrix/variant metadata problem? I'll page eng-runtime and eng-platform.
Priya R: quick triage: routing decision looks correct given current policy config: when ctx_len <=128 we prefer quantized variants for cost reasons. The compatibility matrix entry for model:v2-q4 is missing tool_calling:true — I suspect a matrix migration removed that flag.
Sam C: +1. matrix migration from last week had a conditional that pruned unsupported attributes; for some quant builds it dropped tool_calling even though the model actually supports the RPC.
Jen (oncall): Okay. Immediate mitigation options?
Priya R: We can patch the routing policy to avoid sending requests with an "x-tool-call: true" header to quantized variants, and prefer fp16 for those routes. Applying a hot policy override now.
Tobia L: Runtime will need a quick reload on the router layer. I'm prepping the command to push the override to the smart-routing service.
Priya R: Command I'm about to run (will set no-quant-fallback for tool-call routes):
```
# CLI
redwood route update --name=customer_plans --match-header "x-tool-call:true" --prefer-variant fp16 --disable-quant-fallback true
```
Tobia L: applying override to routers shard-1..4 — restarting router process on shard-2 to pick up policy. Expect ~30s of routing churn while shards reconcile.
Alex M: Customer impact notes for pager/CS: three customers reported immediate failures (two enterprise, one paid beta). Rough estimate ~1.2k failed requests between 2101112200 and 2101112700. Could be more; logs still streaming.
Sam C: Root cause summary so far: compat matrix migration script accidentally removed tool_calling attribute for certain quantized builds. Smart-routing policy uses that matrix plus context-length heuristics, which together routed tool-call traffic to an incompatible variant.
Priya R: Hotfix applied at 2101112608 — policy override in place. Error-rate returning to baseline within minutes on all affected routes. We'll keep the override for 4 hours to be safe while we fix matrix.
Jen (oncall): Good. Jen logging incident as partial outage (sev2 -> customer impact). Notifying CS to reach out to affected customers and to offer retry guidance.
Tobia L: I'll own follow-up: opening PR to revert the matrix migration change and add a guard that refuses to unset tool_calling if a variant binary contains the function schema. Also adding unit tests to the compat-matrix generator.
Sam C: Also adding an end-to-end integration test: route simulator with a small ctx_len + tool_call header should never route to a variant lacking tool_call capability.
Priya R: Putting a short-term alert to detect any future automatic routing overrides that reduce tool_calling-compatible capacity.
Alex M: For the post-incident writeup: timeline, mitigation (policy override -> pin to fp16 for tool_call routes), root cause (matrix migration dropped flag), customer impact, and next steps (matrix hotfix + tests + longer term policy change to separate quantization selection from RPC compatibility).
Jen (oncall): Handing off to Tobia for follow-up. I'll update the on-call log and add CS notes. If anyone finds residual errors, ping me directly.
Tobia L: I'll file the PR and link it here when ready. Tentative actions: (1) matrix rollback/hotfix, (2) add generator guard + tests, (3) update routing policy defaults to never use quant fallback for any route with tool-call header, (4) postmortem in the runbook.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated -> monitoring. All pages paused.
Jen (oncall): Closing the active page. We'll reopen if anything regresses. Thanks team.
Alex M: Thanks all — good catch and quick mitigation.
---
Action items: Tobia: PR for matrix hotfix + tests; Sam: integration test for routing simulator; Priya: remove override after verification window; Jen: CS outreach + postmortem draft.
